items.readable_text:
Content:
Suppose that we want to simplify the following expression:

Content:
[MATH: 2+\dfrac{5}{2}x -5 + \dfrac{7}{2}x.]

Content:
We begin by collecting like terms.

Content:
[MATH: ((5)/(2)x + (7)/(2)x) + (2 − 5)]

Content:
Then, we combine the like terms, simplifying the coefficients as much as possible.

Content:
[MATH: ((5)/(2)x + (7)/(2)x) + (2 − 5)|=; ((5 + 7)/(2))x + (− 3)|=; (12)/(2)x − 3|=; 6x − 3|.]

Content:
Thus, the simplified expression is [MATH: 6x-3.]

Item 1 — Tutorial: Introduction

Content:
Then, we combine the like terms, simplifying the coefficients as much as possible.

Content:
